description: This is a test source file for the AppOverviewItems component in the org.fdroid.database package. It contains unit tests for app overview item retrieval, anti-features, icons, sorting, filtering by author/category, and repository preferences.

classes.name: AppOverviewItemsTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of app overview item retrieval, anti-features, icons, sorting, filtering, and preferences in the org.fdroid.database package.

methods.name: testAntiFeatures
methods.description: Tests that the anti-features of apps are correctly determined based on their versions.

methods.name: testIcons
methods.description: Tests that app icons are correctly retrieved and updated based on repository preferences.

methods.name: testLimit
methods.description: Verifies that the limit parameter correctly restricts the number of app overview items returned.

methods.name: testIncompatibleFlag
methods.description: Checks that the compatibility flag for apps is correctly updated based on their versions.

methods.name: testGetByRepoWeight
methods.description: Ensures that apps are retrieved correctly based on repository weight and preferences.

methods.name: testGetByRepoPref
methods.description: Verifies that repository preferences influence app selection correctly.

methods.name: testSortOrder
methods.description: Checks the sorting order of apps based on icons, summaries, and repository preferences.

methods.name: testSortOrderWithCategories
methods.description: Verifies sorting behavior within specific categories.

methods.name: testOnlyFromEnabledRepos
methods.description: Ensures only apps from enabled repositories are returned.

methods.name: testGetAppOverviewItem
methods.description: Tests retrieval of individual app overview items by repository and package name.

methods.name: testGetAppOverviewItemWithIcons
methods.description: Tests retrieval of app overview items with icon considerations across repositories.
